title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1 te Rruga Mihal Grameno
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe totale 104.8 m2 i ndodhur ne nje objekt ne ndertim buze rruges Mihal Grameno,siper tregut elektrik.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e katert banim te nje objekti,i cili ndodhet ne faze karabina dhe pritet te perfundoje ne Shkurt te vitit 2027.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe neto 88.5 m2 dhe eshte i organizuar ne menyre shume funksionale.
Apartamenti eshte i orientuar nga juglindja,orientim qe mundeson nje diellezim perfekt ne pjesen me te madhe te dites.
Per me shume inforamcion mund te na kontaktoni.
title_en: Apartment 2+1 for sale on Mihal Grameno Street
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale with a total area of ​​104.8 m2, located in a building under construction on the edge of Mihal Grameno street, above the electric market. The apartment is located on the fourth residential floor of a building, which is in the construction phase and is expected to be completed in February 2027. The apartment has a net area of ​​88.5 m2 and is organized in a very functional way. The apartment is oriented to the southeast, an orientation that allows for perfect sunshine during most of the day. For more information you can contact us.
